settings.announcementText: 🎉 Ganesh Festival Offer is LIVE! Get special discounts for a limited time. Grab it now!
settings.announcementTextMarathi: 🙏 गणेशोत्सव स्पेशल ऑफर LIVE! खास सवलतींचा लाभ घ्या, ऑफर मर्यादित काळासाठी!
settings.storeAddress: Aapla JalgaonWala Enterprises, Dehu - Yelwadi Rd, near by yelwadi, kaman, Dehu, Yelwadi, Maharashtra 412109
settings.heroEyebrow: Rooted in Tradition. Crafted for Modern Taste.
settings.heroSubtitle: Authentic banana chips, farsaan, masalas and regional flavours crafted for today's generation. Directly sourced from Jalgaon farms and freshly packed for pure crunch.
settings.heroCardSubtitle: Thin, crispy, and tossed in authentic regional spices
settings.heroPillSubtitle: Celebrate & save with exclusive festive offers!
settings.navratriDescription: Special Navratri Festivity Pack containing 500g Salted Banana Chips, 500g Spicy Masala Banana Chips, 500g Sweet Potato Chivda, 500g Spicy Potato Chivda, and a FREE pack of nutritious Rajgira Ladoos! Made 100% Satvik with Sendha Namak (Rock Salt) in separate dedicated frying lines.
settings.navratriProduct1Name: Sendha Namak Rock Salt Banana Chips (५०० ग्रॅम)
settings.navratriProduct1Desc: Melt-in-your-mouth wafer thin raw banana wafers salted with pure Himalayan Sendha Namak (Rock Salt).
settings.navratriProduct2Name: Spicy Masala Fasting Banana Chips (५०० ग्रॅम)
settings.navratriProduct2Desc: Crispy raw banana wafers tossed with fast-compliant spicy red chilli powder and rock salt.
settings.navratriProduct3Name: Meetha Farali Potato Batata Chivda (५०० ग्रॅम)
settings.navratriProduct3Desc: Crisp hand-grated Jalgaon potato salli blended with premium cashew nuts, sweet raisins, and roasted peanuts.
settings.navratriProduct4Name: Teekha Farali Potato Batata Chivda (५०० ग्रॅम)
settings.navratriProduct4Desc: Thin golden matchstick potato salli seasoned with a spicy Navratri spice mix and crunchy rock salt.
settings.navratriProduct5Desc: Mouthwatering, soft, nutrient-packed amaranth puffed seeds balls sweetened with jaggery/pure sugar.
settings.codAdvanceFeeDescription: A small deposit is required to confirm Cash on Delivery orders and protect against fake/unclaimed shipments. The remaining balance is payable in cash upon delivery.
settings.ourStoryHeroTitle: Rooted in Soil. Crafted for Modern Taste.
settings.ourStoryHeroSubtitle: How two visionaries from Jalgaon connected local farming families directly with snack lovers across India.
